metadata.title: Spring Cloud Gateway and Strangler Pattern Routing

story.iWant: establish a Spring Cloud Gateway embedded in the Spring Boot application that routes requests to either new Spring Boot services or legacy COBOL system
story.soThat: we can gradually migrate traffic without clients knowing about the backend change
story.tasks: 11 tasks covering gateway setup, route configuration, circuit breaker, logging, tracing, CORS, feature toggles, multi-environment config, testing, documentation, and Kubernetes readiness

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Spring Cloud Gateway (4.x) configured as embedded gateway in Spring Boot
Routes configured (configurable via application.yml or database): /api/v1/customers/*, /api/v1/policies/*, /api/v1/audit/*, /api/v1/auth/* with feature toggle support for legacy routing
Request/response logging implemented at gateway level (JSON structured logs with correlation ID)
Circuit breaker configured (Resilience4j) to fail over to legacy if new service is down (50% failure rate threshold, 30s wait)
Timeout handling (5s timeout for downstream services, graceful error response)
CORS headers configured for React frontend (http://localhost:3000 in dev, production domain in prod)
Request tracing ID (X-Trace-Id or correlation ID) added to all requests for distributed tracing
Gateway can be deployed independently and scales horizontally via Kubernetes

dependencies.package: Spring Cloud Gateway embedded router and filter support
Resilience4j integration with Spring Cloud Circuit Breaker
Circuit breaker state machine and transitions
dependencies.note: Spring Cloud version MUST match Spring Boot 3.3 LTS: Spring Cloud 2023.0.x series. Verify in pom.xml parent BOM section.
Resilience4j 2.1+ required for full circuit breaker and timeout handling features.

constraints.constraint: Spring Cloud Gateway MUST be embedded in the Spring Boot application (not a separate microservice) to keep deployment simple and align with cloud-native patterns
Gateway routing logic MUST be configuration-based (Java RouteLocator bean preferred over YAML for flexibility) and reloadable without application restart where possible
Circuit breaker threshold: 50% failure rate (as specified in AC #4). Do NOT deviate from this without approval. Half-open state tests with 1 request, waits 30s before retry.
All downstream timeout: 5 seconds maximum (as specified in AC #5). Configure both connection and read timeouts.
CORS configuration at gateway level TAKES PRECEDENCE over service-level Spring Security CORS. Update Spring Security to remove redundant CORS config (avoid conflicts).
Request tracing correlation ID (X-Trace-Id) MUST flow through: request header → gateway MDC → downstream service header → response header. Integrate with existing LoggingFilter from Story 1.2.
Feature toggles (Unleash integration, Story 1.6) must be checked BEFORE routing. If toggle missing, default to Spring Boot (fail-safe to new system).
All gateway routes MUST support the following HTTP methods: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, OPTIONS (for CORS preflight).
Gateway must emit metrics on: circuit breaker state changes, request counts by route destination (Spring Boot vs legacy), and routing latency per endpoint.
Stateless gateway design (no session affinity needed) to enable horizontal scaling in Kubernetes (Story 1.11).
Document all environment variables for different deployments (dev/test/prod) in README.md.

interface.name: Spring Cloud Gateway RouteLocator
interface.description: Programmatic route configuration bean. Defines predicates (path, method), filters (circuit breaker, logging, CORS), and destinations (Spring Boot or legacy COBOL endpoint). Allows dynamic reloading and feature toggle integration.

interface.name: Resilience4j CircuitBreaker
interface.description: Circuit breaker configuration for legacy COBOL endpoint fallback. State transitions: CLOSED → OPEN (50%+ failures) → HALF_OPEN (after 30s) → CLOSED (recovery) or OPEN (continued failures).

interface.name: GatewayFilter
interface.signature: public Mono<Void> filter(ServerWebExchange exchange, GatewayFilterChain chain)
interface.path: src/main/java/com/example/cicsgenapp/gateway/filter/ (NEW - folder to be created with multiple filter implementations)
interface.description: Custom gateway filters to implement: GatewayLoggingFilter (structured JSON logging), TraceIdFilter (X-Trace-Id propagation), FeatureToggleFilter (Unleash integration), CircuitBreakerFilter (legacy fallback).

interface.name: REST API Endpoints (Downstream Services)
interface.description: All downstream endpoints must be accessible via HTTP. Gateway routes to either http://localhost:8080 (Spring Boot) or http://legacy-cobol-system:8081 (configurable) based on feature toggles.

interface.name: Legacy COBOL System Endpoint
interface.description: Fallback endpoint for legacy COBOL system. Route via circuit breaker; if legacy unavailable, return 503 with standardized error JSON.

interface.name: Unleash Feature Toggle Service
interface.description: Integration point from Story 1.6. Gateway checks toggles: customer-api-enabled, policy-api-enabled before routing. If toggle missing, default to Spring Boot (fail-safe).

tests.standards: Testing strategy follows Spring Boot best practices established in Story 1.2: - Unit tests for route configuration logic (using RouteLocatorBuilder) - Integration tests with @WebFluxTest for gateway filters - TestContainers for containerized mock legacy system during testing - Circuit breaker state transition tests using Resilience4j test utilities - CORS preflight testing (OPTIONS requests) with assertions on response headers - Correlation ID propagation tests (verify X-Trace-Id flows end-to-end) - Load tests using WireMock for mock downstream services (1000+ req/s validation) - Target: 80%+ test coverage for gateway routing logic (filters, predicates, handlers)

locations.location: src/test/resources/wiremock/ (mock response definitions for legacy system simulation)

ideas.idea: Unit test: RouteLocator bean loads successfully and contains all 4 main routes (/api/v1/customers, /api/v1/policies, /api/v1/audit, /api/v1/auth)
Integration test: Route predicates work correctly (path-based, method-based routing to correct backend)
Integration test: Full request flow through gateway with logging and tracing. Verify: request logged with traceId, X-Trace-Id header propagated to downstream, response includes traceId header
Unit test: Circuit breaker state transitions (CLOSED → OPEN when 50%+ fail, HALF_OPEN after 30s, recovery to CLOSED)
Integration test: Legacy system timeout (mock 100% failures) → circuit breaker opens → fallback response (503) returned
Integration test: Downstream service takes >5s → timeout occurs → graceful error response with correct HTTP status
Integration test: CORS preflight (OPTIONS /api/v1/customers) → verify Access-Control-Allow-Origin, Access-Control-Allow-Methods, Access-Control-Allow-Headers present
Integration test: Non-preflight request → verify X-Trace-Id exposed header in CORS response
Integration test: Generate X-Trace-Id if missing header → verify UUID created and propagated through request lifecycle
Load test: Gateway handles 1000+ req/s with proper timeout/pooling, verifies horizontal scalability
Logging test: All request/response logs include JSON fields: timestamp, traceId, method, path, status, latency
Kubernetes readiness test: Deploy 2+ gateway replicas, verify load balancing and stateless behavior
